package student

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput struct {
	Schema          string
	StudentID       string
	RequestID       string
	ExpectedVersion int64
	domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers
}

type FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput struct {
	Schema                 string
	StudentID              string
	RequestID              string
	ExpectedDraftVersion   int64
	ExpectedProfileVersion int64
}

type GetStudentOnboardingDraft struct {
	Drafts repository.StudentOnboardingDraftRepository
}

func (useCase GetStudentOnboardingDraft) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if useCase.Drafts == nil || !validStudentUUID(studentID) {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	draft, err := useCase.Drafts.GetDraft(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, err
	}
	draft, err = domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(draft)
	if err != nil || draft.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return draft, nil
}

type PutStudentOnboardingDraft struct {
	Drafts repository.StudentOnboardingDraftRepository
	Clock  OnboardingClock
}

func (useCase PutStudentOnboardingDraft) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.RequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestID)
	if useCase.Drafts == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || input.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema ||
		!validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) || !validStudentUUID(input.RequestID) || input.ExpectedVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	answers, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraftAnswers(input.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	command := repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand{
		StudentID: input.StudentID, RequestID: input.RequestID, ExpectedVersion: input.ExpectedVersion,
		Answers: answers, OccurredAt: useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}
	command.RequestHash = onboardingDraftReplaceHash(input.Schema, command)
	result, _, err := useCase.Drafts.ReplaceDraft(ctx, command)
	return result, err
}

type FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft struct {
	Drafts repository.StudentOnboardingDraftRepository
	Clock  OnboardingClock
}

func (useCase FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft) Handle(
	ctx context.Context,
	input FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.RequestID = strings.TrimSpace(input.RequestID)
	if useCase.Drafts == nil || useCase.Clock == nil || input.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeCommandSchema ||
		!validStudentUUID(input.StudentID) || !validStudentUUID(input.RequestID) ||
		input.ExpectedDraftVersion < 1 || input.ExpectedProfileVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	command := repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand{
		StudentID: input.StudentID, RequestID: input.RequestID,
		ExpectedDraftVersion: input.ExpectedDraftVersion, ExpectedProfileVersion: input.ExpectedProfileVersion,
		OccurredAt: useCase.Clock.Now().UTC(),
	}
	command.RequestHash = onboardingDraftFinalizeHash(input.Schema, command)
	result, _, err := useCase.Drafts.FinalizeDraft(ctx, command)
	return result, err
}

func onboardingDraftReplaceHash(schema string, command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand) string {
	payload := struct {
		Schema          string                               `json:"schema"`
		StudentID       string                               `json:"student_id"`
		ExpectedVersion int64                                `json:"expected_version"`
		Answers         domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers `json:"answers"`
	}{
		Schema: schema, StudentID: command.StudentID, ExpectedVersion: command.ExpectedVersion, Answers: command.Answers,
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func onboardingDraftFinalizeHash(schema string, command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand) string {
	payload := struct {
		Schema                 string `json:"schema"`
		StudentID              string `json:"student_id"`
		ExpectedDraftVersion   int64  `json:"expected_draft_version"`
		ExpectedProfileVersion int64  `json:"expected_profile_version"`
	}{
		Schema: schema, StudentID: command.StudentID, ExpectedDraftVersion: command.ExpectedDraftVersion,
		ExpectedProfileVersion: command.ExpectedProfileVersion,
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	digest := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}
